newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed AcCell orders exceed contract.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed AcCell orders exceed contract.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said Tuesday that orders from Olympus American Inc, its Western Hemisphere distribution partner, had surpassed the contracted amount of AcCell 2000 and 2001 units for 1996.
Olympus, an affiliate of Olympus Optical Co Ltd, also agreed to purchase additional units.

This new order, received within the first five months of the AccuMed-Olympus distribution agreement, brings the total orders by Olympus to 142 percent of the minimum quantities guaranteed for the entire first year of the agreement.
AccuMed said the accelerated and high-volume ordering of the AcCell system will require its production operations to expand into a two-shift manufacturing schedule.
The AcCell system is used in the analysis and diagnosis of Pap smear screening.

"We are gratified by Olympus' response to the AcCell system," Peter Gombrich, chairman, said in a statement. "Together we are committed to demonstrating that there is a new cost-effective way to improve the quality and productivity of cervical cancer screening and reduce liability concerns, while, at the same time, complying with regulatory issues."
